= MCQ QUIZ GENERATION PROMPT (TEMPLATE)

I’ll give you the text of SOURCE(S), and I’d like you to use the instructions below to generate a high-quality MCQ quiz from that material.

EXAMPLE OUTPUT STRUCTURE

Question text here
A. Option A
B. Option B
C. Option C
D. Option D
Correct Answer: C
Explanation: Brief explanation of why this option is correct.

(Next question with identical structure)

INSTRUCTIONS TO FOLLOW

Question Count & Difficulty
– Generate {{ $('Webhook').item.json.body.no_of_questions }} MCQs unless the user specifies otherwise.
– Mix difficulty levels: basic recall, conceptual understanding, and applied reasoning.
– Every question must directly reference or be grounded in the SOURCE(S).

Question Design
– Ensure each question tests a meaningful idea, concept, or detail.
– Avoid trivial or overly narrow questions.
– Avoid ambiguous wording; each question must have one clearly correct answer.
– Use a variety of question styles:
• “Which of the following…”
• “What is the primary purpose of…”
• “According to the source…”
• “Which statement is TRUE/FALSE based on the material…”

Answer Options
– Provide exactly four answer options (A–D).
– Distractors should be plausible and relevant to the SOURCE(S).
– Avoid joke answers or options that are obviously incorrect.

Correct Answer & Explanation
– Clearly label the correct answer after each question.
– Provide a concise explanation (1–3 sentences) showing why the correct answer is right and the others are not.
– Explanations should enhance understanding and connect to the SOURCE(S).

Clarity & Tone
– Use clear, accessible, and student-friendly language.
– Avoid unnecessary jargon unless required by the SOURCE(S).
– Ensure the quiz feels engaging, informative, and academically sound.

Formatting Requirements
– Present questions in a numbered list (1–10).
– Each question must follow the exact format shown in the example.
– Use \n between questions and sections.
– DO NOT include narrator text, extra commentary, citations, or URLs.
– Only output the quiz itself.

SOURCE(S) TO CREATE THE QUIZ FROM
